profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Rewards Network
profile.summary: Software Engineer at Rewards Network. B.S. in Computer Science from the University of Illinois at Chicago (2021) and MCS from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (2025).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Acquisition: I worked a Software Engineer at UnitedHealth Group, formerly Rally Health, where I was hired in January 2022. I continued to work on the same team and products after the acquisition.

➥ Served as the go-to Secondary Subject Matter Expert for Rally's SSO service, leading the integration of over 15 large enterprise customers by managing requirements and resolving live site issues. Developed new features to expand use cases, and served as the point of contact for SSO-related inquiries.
➥ Drove enhancements across SSO, session management, and healthcare plan selection, including a key automation that improved available database space by 30%, and played a role in developing UHG's plan-selector service, ensuring seamless integration with Rally's eligibility service.
➥ Enhanced customer support and issue resolution as part of on-call team, significantly improving alert response times through the development of comprehensive DataDog monitors and widgets.
➥ Containerized Rally PingFederate service using Docker and Kubernetes, surpassing the limitations of Amazon EC2 for streamlined deployments and enhanced performance.
➥ Technologies: Scala, Kotlin, Play Framework, React, AWS, PostgreSQL, DataDog, Splunk

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
➥ Designed and implemented a utility for SSO-out, featuring serialization and deserialization of JWE tokens and an API for generating JWE tokens for SSO authorization.
➥ Developed and executed a data migration job using Scala and Doobie, which cleaned and processed data before populating PostgreSQL databases across multiple AWS tenants in integration and production environments.
➥ Wrote thoroughly tested, production-ready code that achieved 100% coverage.
➥ Technologies used: Scala, Play Framework, Doobie, PostgreSQL, and AWS.

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description:
➥ Created the company's IAM system, delivering a comprehensive solution for user authentication using Google Firebase and authorization using a combination of PostgreSQL and GoLang.
➥ Integrated the authentication service with Okta, enabling support for OpenID and SAML login methods.
➥ Developed a Vue.js-based internal dashboard for customer onboarding, management of SAAS application integrations, and customer data management. Deployed the dashboard on Google Firebase.
➥ Created various GoLang APIs for user account management, customer onboarding, customer data access and management, and third-party SAAS integrations. Deployed the APIs on Google App Engine.
➥ Technologies used: GoLang, PostgreSQL, Vue.js, GCP.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Student Affairs Department:
➥ Developed an API using Node.js, Express.js, and MSSQL, providing 27 departments at UIC with the ability to create and manage campus events. Designed and implemented a website using Vue.js, which utilizes the API and is currently in use by UIC faculty and organizers.
➥ Designed and executed scheduled tasks using C# on a Windows Server for data migration, AD group automation, and uploads of third-party API data using .NET Core.
➥ Created a website and API for the UIC locker reservation system, now utilized by students for reserving physical lockers across the UIC campus.
➥ Technologies used: Node.js, Express.js, Vue.js, MSSQL, C#.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Campus Housing Department:
➥ Developed web applications using PHP, Javascript, and Oracle SQL for campus housing systems.
➥ Managed JIRA tickets for existing applications, fixing bugs and implementing updates.
➥ Technologies used: PHP, Javascript, Oracle SQL.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
➥ Collaborated with a team of engineers on the development of an SSO application using Scala and the Play Framework.
➥ Completed an internship project that involved developing APIs for managing SSO configurations.
➥ Conducted research and delivered the initial version of production-ready code using a new Scala library, Doobie.
➥ Technologies used: Scala, Play Framework, Doobie, PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
➥ Collaborated with a team of interns to develop a web-based IDE for automating the creation of Gherkin test scripts for business teams at Optum.
➥ Utilized Python for data handling scripts and GitHub integration.
➥ Deployed the application on the web using the Django web framework.
➥ Implemented the frontend of the application using Vue.js, featuring live code previews and a user-friendly interface for the IDE.
➥ Technologies used: Python, Django, Vue.js.

positions.title: Retail Sales Associate
positions.description: ➥ Accountable for overseeing the sales floor, providing customer support for our services and products, and collaborating with a team to manage the store operations.

honors.title: Advanced Placement Scholar with Distinction
honors.description: Granted to students who receive an average score of at least 3.5 on all AP Exams taken, and scores of 3 or higher on five or more of these exams.

honors.title: ISAC State Scholar
honors.description:
SAT Score: 1580
Awarded to Illinois students who perform in the top one-half of your high school class at the end of the third semester before graduation, and/or score at or above the 95th percentile on the ACT or SAT.

volunteerExperiences.description: Judge rounds for Lincoln-Douglas debates at high school tournaments.

projects.title: Building Innovations Inc. Website
projects.description:
Freelance website project built for Building Innovations Inc.
➥ SquareSpace 7.1

projects.title: UIC Grade Portal
projects.description:
Grade Portal website built for Professor Dale Reed to allow students in his classes to check their grades. Makes grades accessible to the class through individual student profile pages.
➥ Python scripts for data parsing
➥ Flask for the web application
➥ PostgreSQL database

testScores.name: SAT
testScores.description:
800 Math, 780 Reading/Writing
Equivalent of a 36 on the ACT
